# Strikethrough

Plain text beside ~~deleted words~~ and a ~single-tilde phrase~.

~~**Bold words**, *italic words*, [linked words](https://example.com), and `inline code` keep their own styles.~~

Move into this ~~active phrase~~ to reveal its editable markers.

~~A longer sentence wraps naturally across several visual rows when the writing column becomes narrow. Each row keeps a measured strike through its own text.~~

~~café é 🧑‍💻 שלום עולם and العربية~~

> ~~A quotation keeps its muted semantic color.~~

| Left | Right |
|:---|---:|
| ~~table cell~~ | ~~**another cell**~~ |

Escaped \~literal\~ and code `~~literal~~` retain their literal tildes.
